description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rawatawatta, D/S Division, Moratuwa, Colombo District - Cad. Map No.520201 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land titles, ownership registration, and property-related legal determinations.
